example: the selection before the first heading

steps.line: * Given a notebook with the lines "Intro." and "# Tasks" is open

expect.why: the notebook's whole text is open
the window shows the lines "Intro." and "# Tasks", in that order
the selection lies within the line "Intro."

steps.line: * When the user opens the View menu

expect.why: View was pressed in the menu bar with palantir in front, which opens the View menu

steps.line: * Then Fold Heading and Unfold Heading are disabled

expect.that: [.menus.items[] | select(.path == "View > Fold Heading")] | (length == 1 and all(.enabled == false))
expect.why: View > Fold Heading is disabled in the open View menu

expect.that: [.menus.items[] | select(.path == "View > Unfold Heading")] | (length == 1 and all(.enabled == false))
expect.why: View > Unfold Heading is disabled in the open View menu
